description: This header file defines the API for a dynamic string vector data structure called 'strvec'. It includes structure definitions, macros for initialization, and function prototypes for operating on dynamic string arrays, such as creation, modification, splitting, and cleanup.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure to an empty state.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string into the vector.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes an allocated string into the vector, taking ownership.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string and pushes it onto the vector.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a list of strings onto the vector, argument terminated by NULL.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings onto the vector.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the vector with provided strings, allowing insertion or deletion.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the element at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string by whitespace into the vector; does not handle quotes.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the vector.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array, relinquishing control to the caller.
